title.value: Resting-state connectivity stratifies premanifest Huntington’s disease by longitudinal cognitive decline rate
title.justification: The title precisely reflects the study's objective and methodology, focusing on the stratification of premanifest Huntington’s disease via resting-state connectivity and cognitive decline metrics.
title.quote: Resting-state connectivity stratifies premanifest Huntington’s disease by longitudinal cognitive decline rate

analysis.description: The paper investigates the use of resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) data to stratify premanifest Huntington’s disease patients based on their cognitive and motor decline rates. Using functional connectivity density (FCD) maps, the study identifies subgroups of fast and slow progressors and validates the models across different imaging sites. The study suggests potential applications in clinical trials for early-stage interventions.
